public.admin_dashboard_summary.name: admin_dashboard_summary
public.admin_dashboard_summary.definition: SELECT count(DISTINCT students.id) AS total_students, count(DISTINCT faculty.id) AS total_faculty, count(DISTINCT sessions.id) AS total_sessions FROM students, faculty, sessions

public.faculty_monthly_hours.name: faculty_monthly_hours
public.faculty_monthly_hours.definition: SELECT faculty_id, date_trunc('month'::text, session_date::timestamp with time zone) AS month, count(*) AS sessions, sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM end_time - start_time) / 3600::numeric) AS hours FROM sessions WHERE status = 'completed'::session_status GROUP BY faculty_id, (date_trunc('month'::text, session_date::timestamp with time zone))

public.student_attendance_summary.name: student_attendance_summary
public.student_attendance_summary.definition: SELECT student_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'present'::attendance_status)::numeric * 100.0 / count(*)::numeric AS attendance_percentage FROM attendance_records GROUP BY student_id
